about:
Founded in 2014, HK Textile Inc. is headquartered in Yonkers, New York. The company was established with the goal of supplying bed and bath collections that combine casual style with affordable luxury, drawing inspiration from the blend of modern trends and classic New York aesthetics that characterize its location.

The firm operates its own production facilities, handling weaving, dyeing, and stitching in-house, and employs computer-aided design to develop new patterns. Its product line spans bath towels, pool and beach towels, hand towels, wash cloths, bar mops, kitchen and shop towels, institutional towels, bathrobes, and terry bibs, all made from materials such as 100% ring-spun cotton and environmentally friendly yarns.

HK Textile serves both retail and institutional markets. Its institutional towel division caters to a broad range of commercial customers, including hospitality and healthcare sectors, while its bath and bathrobe collections target home consumers seeking quality and comfort.

The company emphasizes social, ethical, and environmental responsibility as part of its mission, stating that it uses the finest yarns and aims to deliver value globally through innovative technology and an efficient workforce. This commitment to sustainable luxury is presented as the core differentiator behind its product offering.
